info.title: Flowy App API
info.description:
Run Flowy apps and direct generations programmatically.

Authenticate with a workspace API key in the `Authorization: Bearer` header. A **secret** key (`flowy_…`) is for servers; a **publishable** key (`flowy_pk_…`) is browser-safe and only works from its allowlisted domains. Every run or generation bills the API key's own workspace credits (caller-pays), so a leaked key can never spend another workspace's balance.

Keys carry **scopes**: `apps:read` (list/inspect apps), `runs:read` (poll runs), `runs:write` (start runs), `generations:read` (poll direct generations), `generations:write` (start direct generations), `assets:read` (list/read workspace assets), and `credits:read` (read the credit balance). A request that needs a scope the key doesn't hold returns `403`.

A published (public) app is runnable by any key; a private app is runnable only by a key of its own workspace.

ApiKeyAuth.description: A workspace API key. Secret keys (`flowy_…`) are server-side — keep them private. Publishable keys (`flowy_pk_…`) are browser-safe but only work from their allowlisted domains.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window (per minute).

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix epoch second at which the current window resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (sent on 429).

error.example: this API key lacks the runs:write scope

url.description: Signed, downloadable media URL — present for media outputs; expires.

text.description: Text result — present for text outputs.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when status is failed.

description.example: Turn a selfie into a studio headshot.
Turn a selfie into a studio headshot.

name.description: The public key to use as `node_id` in the run request.

arity.description: Present on a VARIADIC input: the run accepts between `min` and `max` values for this one key — send them as an array-valued `asset_url`/`prompt`.

inputs.description: Input field schema; each item's `name` is the `node_id` to send in the run request's `inputs` array. Items carrying `arity` are variadic (array-valued).

prompt.example: a studio photo of a ceramic mug on a marble counter

input_media.description: Optional reference media: an asset from your workspace library (asset_id) or a public URL. Video generations accept up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio references (12 total).

estimatedCredits.description: Credits reserved for this generation; the settled charge arrives on the generation view.

progress.description: Best-effort live progress snapshot; present only while processing.

prompt.example: a studio photo of a ceramic mug on a marble counter

assetId.description: Library asset id, when the output was recorded as an asset.

creditsCharged.description: Credits actually deducted; 0 until the generation completes.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when status is failed.

prompt.description: The generation prompt, for generated assets.

credits.description: Total credits on the workspace wallet.

node_id.description: The input's `name` from GET /v1/apps/{appId} (its kebab-cased title). Raw node ids are also accepted for flows published before titles.

asset_url.description: Media value: a publicly fetchable URL. An ARRAY provides multiple values for a variadic input (one published with `arity`): between `arity.min` and `arity.max` entries, in order.

prompt.description: Text value. An ARRAY provides multiple values for a variadic input (one published with `arity`): between `arity.min` and `arity.max` entries, in order.

asset_urls.description: Plural equivalent of an array-valued `asset_url`; entries are appended in order.

get.description: Lists the active apps in the authenticated key's workspace. **Requires the `apps:read` scope.**

403.description: The key lacks the apps:read scope

get.description: Returns an app's identity plus its input/output schema. Use each input's `nodeId` as the key in the run request's `inputs` map. Allowed when the app is published (any key) or belongs to the key's own workspace. **Requires the `apps:read` scope.**

403.description: Private app not in your workspace, or the key lacks the apps:read scope

post.description: Starts an asynchronous run, billed to the key's workspace. Returns immediately with a `runId` — poll `GET /v1/runs/{runId}` for the result. Omit the body for an app with no inputs. **Requires the `runs:write` scope.**

inputs.description: One entry per flow input. A variadic input (see `arity` on GET /v1/apps/{appId}) takes ONE entry whose `asset_url`/`prompt` is an array of its values; values beyond `arity.max` are ignored. Repeating the same `node_id` across entries is an accepted equivalent.

402.description: Daily spend cap reached or insufficient workspace credits

403.description: Private app not in your workspace, or the key lacks the runs:write scope

429.description: Rate limit or concurrency limit exceeded

get.description: Returns a run's status and, once complete, its outputs (signed, downloadable media URLs). Only runs started by your own workspace are visible. **Requires the `runs:read` scope.**

403.description: Run belongs to another workspace, or the key lacks the runs:read scope

post.description: Starts an asynchronous image or video generation, billed to the key's workspace. Returns immediately with a `generationId` — poll `GET /v1/generations/{generationId}` for the result. Completed outputs are also recorded in the workspace asset library. **Requires the `generations:write` scope.**

workspace_id.description: Optionally bill a different workspace the account can manage; default is the key's own wallet.
